text:
Maya K: Thinking about doing a 'global snack swap' for the office day next Friday — everyone bring one snack from a place you've visited? :earth_americas:
Jon P: Love this idea. quick ask: anyone got fast recs for Manchester airport food? flying in Thursday evening, 45min layover.
Li Wei: At MAN the pizza slice place near gate 4 is legit, but security line can be long. If you only have 45 min, grab `Gino's` by the central concourse — fresh slice + coffee.
Samira: For Manchester, if you can stretch to 60min, The Refuge (Piccadilly) is solid for a roast dinner, but prob not possible with a layover. so airport pizza it is :pizza:
Riley: Heads-up — if you're switching terminals, avoid the sandwich kiosk near gate 12, stale bread yesterday.
Devendra: Seoul tip for anyone heading to ICN next month: little kimbap stalls in Terminal 2 food court, cheap and fast. Also `Myeongdong Dakgalbi` near Exit 4 if you have spare time.
Maya K: @Riley @Devendra nice, please add to the travel recs doc later. Also thinking about snack swap sign-up — I'll make a Google sheet, want country + 3-ingredient list.
Jon P: Sheet sounds good. can we do allergy flag column? nut/soy/dairy maybe.
Samira: yes pls add allergy column. i will bring something nut-free from Jakarta (kue lapis?) if that helps.
TacoBot: :taco: Poll created: "Snack preference — savory vs sweet vs spicy" (react to vote)
Li Wei: Lisbon rec for short layover: `Casa do Prego` in Cais do Sodré for quick pre-flight sandwiches, 12-15min from airport by taxi. Good for cheese + sardines if you're adventurous.
Riley: Quick pro tip — if you have under 30min in EU airports, prioritize places with visible prep counters (makes service faster). also use contactless pay to save time.
Devendra: For long stops in Seoul, street toast (gilgeori toast) is a lifesaver — under 10 minutes and filling.
Jon P: Noted — thanks everyone. Maya, what time next Friday are we doing the swap? morning coffee meet?
Maya K: Let's do 11:30am in the big kitchen area, bring a little sign for origin and any warnings. i'll drop the sheet in #lunch-plans and pin it.
Samira: i'll put a tiny map card with my snack so people know it's jakarta style.
Riley: If anyone's traveling to Manchester DM me, I have a friend who works at the airport and can check gate restaurant statuses.
Maya K: Perfect — thanks all. and @TacoBot ty for the poll. :raised_hands:
